findings: the prior plan did not close the crash window between consuming a Lease, calling a provider and appending a Receipt
ActionReceipt, AIP-4 UsageReceipt and lineage existed as separate authorities without an exact delivery join
provider output schema, redaction, complete content hash and governed evidence extraction were underspecified
provider applied, budget settled and lineage projected could be misread as one success state
durable ActionExecutionAttempt and dispatch outbox now bridge the non-atomic provider boundary without blind retries
ActionReceipt freezes actionBindingHash and all execution authorities while raw output is governed through a controlled Artifact
Usage and settlement preserve measured, estimated and unknown semantics and do not coerce missing cost to zero
deterministic lineage projection binds the complete controlled Receipt hash and exposes projection lag honestly
execution, settlement and lineage remain separate visible states
W5-04 remains unchecked until W5-03 and all named delivery-bridge dependencies are GREEN
